name: handoff
description: At a configurable token threshold (default 250k), offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat, shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a new chat with it. Logs every run to ~/.claude/handoffs/handoff.log and saves a draft first

threshold_tokens.title: Refresh threshold (tokens)
threshold_tokens.description: The context size, in tokens, at which the Refresh offer opens.
